errors.text: The proposed SLM-plus-annealing route does not reconstruct the hydride-based ink extrusion, hydrogen de-binding, high-vacuum sintering, and water-quenching route.
The proposed W-Ta-Cr-V-Hf composition includes Group VI elements W and Cr and does not match the Group IV-V equiatomic HfNbTaTiZr family.
The central claim that vacuum annealing mimics irradiation-induced ballistic homogenization is not supported by the cited irradiation evidence.

The hypothesis treats interstitials primarily as contaminants to homogenize or suppress, whereas the target relies on controlled oxygen uptake near 1 wt.% for strengthening while avoiding excess embrittlement.
It omits hydride decomposition-driven in-situ alloying, oxygen scavenging, quench retention of metastable beta-BCC, and the silicide coating required for oxidation resistance.
